sentences.zh: 好的，如果需要的话给我发短信或打电话。

sentences.en: It was really nice talking.
sentences.zh: 很高兴聊天。

sentences.en: Brooke and her mom hugged and kissed each other.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克和她妈妈拥抱并亲吻了对方。

sentences.en: First day back.
sentences.zh: 重返学校的第一天。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Love you.
sentences.zh: 爱你。

sentences.en: And she hops out of the car and heads back into school.
sentences.zh: 然后她跳下车，朝学校走去。

sentences.en: I love you, too.
sentences.zh: 我也爱你。

sentences.en: One year after the shooting, my colleague, producer Claire Tennis-Sketter, spoke with Brooke and some of the other students.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件发生一年后，我的同事、制作人克莱尔·滕尼斯-斯凯特采访了布鲁克和其他一些学生。

sentences.en: Was there ever a day when it felt normal, ever, like, in your whole last school year?
sentences.zh: 曾经有过哪怕一天，让你觉得一切正常吗，在过去的整个学年里？

sentences.en: It kind of never feels normal.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像永远都不正常。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But, like, we have, like, a new normal, I feel like.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们有一种新常态，我觉得。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: My normal is, like...
sentences.zh: 我的常态是，像……

sentences.en: About how they were navigating the rest of high school.
sentences.zh: 关于他们如何度过剩下的高中生活。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I just feel, like, so guilty.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得好内疚。

sentences.en: It's like getting up every day.
sentences.zh: 就像每天早上醒来一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like, sometimes.
sentences.zh: 就像，有时。

sentences.en: Like, they're supposed to be here.
sentences.zh: 就像，他们本应该在这里的。

sentences.en: Like, that whole thing wasn't supposed to happen.
sentences.zh: 就像，整件事本不该发生一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Brooke and her classmates graduated from Douglas High School last year.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克和她的同班同学去年从道格拉斯高中毕业了。

sentences.en: They were the final class of students to have attended the school at the time of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 他们是枪击事件发生时最后一届就读该校的学生。

sentences.en: Recently, Claire called Brooke one final time to find out what's happened in her life since.
sentences.zh: 最近，克莱尔最后一次打电话给布鲁克，了解她之后的生活。

sentences.en: Hi, Brooke.
sentences.zh: 嗨，布鲁克。

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: It's going good.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: How about you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Good, good.
sentences.zh: 很好，很好。

sentences.en: Thank you for making time to chat.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间聊天。

sentences.en: Oh, no problem.
sentences.zh: 哦，没问题。

sentences.en: So, Brooke, tell me a little bit about your life now.
sentences.zh: 那么，布鲁克，跟我讲讲你现在的生活吧。

sentences.en: What's it like?
sentences.zh: 是什么样的？

sentences.en: Um, well, I am now a sophomore at Emerson College in Boston, Massachusetts, and I couldn't be happier, really.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我现在是马萨诸塞州波士顿爱默生学院的一名大二学生，真的再高兴不过了。

sentences.en: It's the happiest I've been, like, in a really long time, and it was my number one choice of school, and I love it.
sentences.zh: 这是我好久以来最开心的时候，这是我心目中的第一志愿学校，我太喜欢它了。

sentences.en: I love every second of it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它的每一秒钟。

sentences.en: And is any part of that love, like, related to getting away from the dark history that's attached to Parkland?
sentences.zh: 这种喜爱，有任何一部分是因为逃离了附着在帕克兰身上的黑暗历史吗？

sentences.en: Oh, it definitely is.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是的。

sentences.en: I think everyone, like, imagines, like, graduating high school.
sentences.zh: 我想每个人都会想象高中毕业的场景。

sentences.en: Like, when you're a teenager, you're like, oh, I, like, can't wait to be independent.
sentences.zh: 当你还是个青少年时，你会想，哦，我迫不及待地想要独立。

sentences.en: But, like, for me, it felt like, oh, my God, like, I'm finally, like, free from this place that has, like, caused me so much, like, pain and, like, torment.
sentences.zh: 但是对我来说，感觉就像是，天哪，我终于从这个给我带来如此多痛苦和折磨的地方解脱了。

sentences.en: And who has, like, drastically, like, affected, like, my mental health.
sentences.zh: 而且它还极大地影响了我的心理健康。

sentences.en: I knew for a fact that, like, for college, like, I needed to get away and have, like, my own space and be, like, in a place where that, like, couldn't really necessarily, like,
sentences.zh: 我确切地知道，对于大学，我需要离开并拥有自己的空间，去到一个这种事不能完全跟随我的地方，

sentences.en: follow me completely, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 如果这能说得通的话。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼，嗯哼。

sentences.en: Has it followed you?
sentences.zh: 它跟着你了吗？

sentences.en: Um, in ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在某种程度上。

sentences.en: Like, I had to celebrate my, like, first anniversary, like, without, like, my family or, like, without being in my hometown, like, in college.
sentences.zh: 比如，我不得不在没有家人陪伴、也不在家乡的情况下，在大学里庆祝我的第一个周年纪念日。

sentences.en: But my roommate is also from Douglas, so we both got to be there for each other.
sentences.zh: 但我的室友也是道格拉斯人，所以我们都能在彼此身边守望相助。

sentences.en: And, like, it's been nice to have someone, like, there for me who I know is, like, going to give me that comfort that, like, I need in that moment.
sentences.zh: 而且，身边能有这样一个人，我知道她会给予我那一刻我需要的慰藉，这感觉真好。

sentences.en: And what's it like at college?
sentences.zh: 大学生活怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm just curious, is being from Parkland, is that part of your identity?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，来自帕克兰，这是你身份的一部分吗？

sentences.en: Is it something people know about you or is that more private?
sentences.zh: 这是人们都知道的事情，还是比较私人的？

sentences.en: Um, it's one of those things where if I decide that you're going to be someone that I get close to, that it's something I have to share.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是那种如果我决定让你成为我亲近的人，我就必须分享的事情。

sentences.en: And that's, like, something that I've kind of struggled with, like, ever since the shooting happens.
sentences.zh: 而且自从枪击事件发生以来，我一直都在为此苦恼。

sentences.en: Like, that realization that with every, like, close friendship I want to have or, like, relationship or, like, partnership I want to have in the future,
sentences.zh: 就像那种意识到，我想在未来拥有的每一段亲密友谊、每一段恋情或每一段伴侣关系中，

sentences.en: that is something I have to share with them for them to truly, like, know me and, like, understand me.
sentences.zh: 这都是我必须与他们分享的事，这样他们才能真正了解我、理解我。

sentences.en: Why is that, Brooke?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样，布鲁克？

sentences.en: Why do you want people to know?
sentences.zh: 为什么你想让别人知道？

sentences.en: Well, just from a mental health standpoint, like, I have just, like, sometimes really bad PTSD.
sentences.zh: 嗯，仅从心理健康的角度来看，我有有时非常严重的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）。

sentences.en: And, like, I do have, like, anxiety attacks.
sentences.zh: 而且，我确实会有焦虑发作。

sentences.en: And sometimes I do go into, like, miniature, like, depression episodes, like, when a school shooting comes up, like, that will last for, like, a couple days.
sentences.zh: 有时每当学校枪击事件发生时，我确实会陷入轻度的抑郁期，会持续好几天。

sentences.en: And also, like, it is kind of, like, a trigger warning as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，这也算是一种触发预警。

sentences.en: Like, maybe if, like, a shooting just happened, maybe, like, if I tell you that, you think twice before you're just, like, talking about it all the time.
sentences.zh: 也许如果刚发生了枪击案，也许如果我告诉你这个，你在一直谈论它之前就会三思而后行。

sentences.en: And what's it been like?
sentences.zh: 感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Of course, there, unfortunately, have been more shootings in the past four and a half years.
sentences.zh: 当然，不幸的是，在过去四年半里还发生过更多的枪击事件。

sentences.en: What's it been like for you to live through these shootings, like, you've all day recently?
sentences.zh: 经历这些枪击事件对你来说是什么感觉，比如你最近一整天都在经历的这些？

sentences.en: It just feels like a slap in the face.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像当众被打了一巴掌。

sentences.en: Like, to be honest, like, I'm always, like, sad every time because I remember, like, what it was like, like, to live through that every day.
sentences.zh: 老实说，每次我都很难过，因为我想起每天经历那种事是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Like, I can remember it literally like it was yesterday.
sentences.zh: 就像我真的能清晰地记得，仿佛它就发生在昨天。

sentences.en: And especially, like, when you see, like, all, like, the people who's died, like, their families.
sentences.zh: 特别是当你看到所有死去的人以及他们的家属时。

sentences.en: And, like, especially, like, when it's kids, like, young, young kids, like, at elementary schools, like, it just breaks your heart.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当受害者是孩子时，那么小、那么小的孩子，在小学里，这真的让人心碎。

sentences.en: And it feels like no matter, like, what we do, like, nothing ever really changes.
sentences.zh: 感觉无论我们做什么，似乎一切都没有真正改变。

sentences.en: And it is just, like, the biggest slap in the face.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像是最响亮的当头一棒。

sentences.en: And it is constantly re-triggering, especially when I see the same failures that I see, like, in my, like, high school.
sentences.zh: 而且这会不断勾起创伤，特别是当我看到和我在高中时一样的失职现象时。

sentences.en: Where, like, cops aren't going in to help in.
sentences.zh: 比如警察不进去救人。

sentences.en: And, like, they're telling people, like, to stay back and just, like, not doing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 而且他们告诉人们待在后面，却不做好他们的本职工作。

sentences.en: I just get, like, very angry.
sentences.zh: 我只会感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And it's completely heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 这完全是让人心碎。

sentences.en: Brooke, do you stay in touch with your classmates from Stoneman Douglas?
sentences.zh: 布鲁克，你还和斯托曼道格拉斯高中的同学们保持联系吗？

sentences.en: To be honest, no.
sentences.zh: 说实话，没有。

sentences.en: The only time that we really talk to each other is we have this group chat on Snapchat.
sentences.zh: 我们真正会聊天的时候只有在Snapchat的一个群聊里。

sentences.en: And every, like, anniversary or even sometimes when there's, like, a shooting that's, like, all over the news.
sentences.zh: 而且每次，比如周年纪念日，或者有时甚至像新闻里到处都是枪击案的时候。

sentences.en: We'll, like, reach out to each other and be, like, love you guys.
sentences.zh: 我们会互相联系，说，爱你们哦。

sentences.en: Like, hope we're all doing okay.
sentences.zh: 比如，希望我们都好好的。

sentences.en: But constantly in touch, no.
sentences.zh: 但要说经常保持联系，并没有。

sentences.en: The trial of the shooter is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 枪手的审判正在进行中。

sentences.en: What has that been like for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是怎么样的经历？

sentences.en: Um, it's been very hard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这非常艰难。

sentences.en: I've watched, um, all of the trial videos from people that have been in my classroom.
sentences.zh: 我看了，嗯，所有我教室里那些人的审判视频。

sentences.en: And that was unbelievably hard to watch because it's supposed to, like, so many of them were saying, like, things that I have, like, vivid in my memory as well.
sentences.zh: 看那些真的难以置信的难受，因为应该，就像，他们当中有很多人说的话，我记忆犹新。

sentences.en: And so, like, it's very hard to, like, have someone else, like, basically tell, like, your memories back to you but through, like, their own lens.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像，很难去接受别人，基本上是把你的记忆，通过他们自己的视角再复述给你听。

sentences.en: Like, I had, like, a full, like, mental breakdown about it that, like, we still have to, like, deal with this.
sentences.zh: 就像，我为此彻底精神崩溃了，因为我们居然还要面对这种事。

sentences.en: And, like, especially, like, felt so bad.
sentences.zh: 而且，感觉特别糟糕。

sentences.en: Like, everyone in that room, like, had to, like, look at the shooter and, like, make eye contact with him.
sentences.zh: 房间里的每个人，都不得不看着那个枪手，跟他有眼神接触。

sentences.en: But some of them even had to, like, point him out in the room and, like, fully, like, acknowledge that man.
sentences.zh: 但他们有些人甚至还必须在法庭上指出他，完全去直面那个男人。

sentences.en: And I thought I was going to have to do it.
sentences.zh: 我以为我也得这么做。

sentences.en: And a wave of, like, relief went through me, like, when I realized I didn't have to.
sentences.zh: 当我意识到我不用这样做时，一阵解脱感涌上心头。

sentences.en: But then what happens, like, when you're in this kind of connected thing with people is that you realize if you're not doing something, that someone else is.
sentences.zh: 但接下来会发生什么呢，当你和大家有这种紧密联系时，你会意识到如果自己什么都不做，别人就会去做。

sentences.en: Like, if I'm not going to that rally, then they are.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果我不去参加那个集会，他们就会去。

sentences.en: If I'm not giving this interview, they are.
sentences.zh: 如果我不接受这个采访，他们就会接受。

sentences.en: If I'm not going on this trial, they are.
sentences.zh: 如果我不出席这场审判，他们就会出席。

sentences.en: And what does that feel like?
sentences.zh: 那感觉是怎么样的？

sentences.en: Honestly, it's still, like, survivor's guilt and, like, or, like, just really just general guilt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，依然会有幸存者愧疚，或者说，就是纯粹的普遍愧疚。

sentences.en: Because you realize while you get, like, a second, like, to breathe and to kind of be at peace and not put yourself through something extremely, like, triggering and, like,
sentences.zh: 因为你意识到，当你获得了一秒钟的喘息机会，能稍微平静一下，不用经历极度引发创伤的事情时……

sentences.en: traumatic, they do.
sentences.zh: 而他们却要承受。

sentences.en: So even though all the students who witnessed that day have moved on, it's still with all of them.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管那天目睹一切的学生们已经生活向前看，但它依然留在了他们所有人心中。

sentences.en: Oh, a thousand percent.
sentences.zh: 哦，百分之千是的。

sentences.en: And I think, like, sadly, it's going to be something that's with us for, like, the rest of our lives.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，可悲的是，这将伴随我们度过余生。

sentences.en: And I think as, like, we get older, we'll just learn how to, like, process it and deal with it and, like, how to manage it better.
sentences.zh: 我觉得随着我们年龄增长，我们会学会如何去消化、处理它，以及如何更好地应对它。

sentences.en: But I think it's something that's with us for forever.
sentences.zh: 但我认为有些东西会永远伴随着我们。

sentences.en: Because how could it not be?
sentences.zh: 因为怎么可能不呢？

sentences.en: While, like, the shooting definitely did shape me, I'm, like, so much more than that, like, horrible, that I am so much more than this, like, survivor and statistic.
sentences.zh: 虽然枪击案确实塑造了我，但我的分量远不止于那个可怕的事件，我远不止是一个幸存者和统计数字。

sentences.en: I, like, am my own person, like, in general.
sentences.zh: 总体来说，我有我自己的个性。

sentences.en: And I think not being constantly surrounded by that has, like, really reflected that to me, that I am my own person and that what happened to me and, like, my community is not me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有被这些事时时包围，真的让我意识到，我是一个独立的个体，发生在我身上以及我们社区的事情并不代表我。

sentences.en: Thank you, Brooke.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，布鲁克。

sentences.en: Aw, anytime.
sentences.zh: 不客气，随时奉陪。

sentences.en: Have a good one.
sentences.zh: 祝你过得愉快。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费畅读？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》App，获得30天免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Mikhail Gorbachev, the Soviet reformer who ended the Cold War, died on Tuesday in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 苏联改革家、终结冷战的米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫于周二在莫斯科逝世。

sentences.en: He was 91.
sentences.zh: 享年91岁。

sentences.en: In his six years in power, Gorbachev tried to modernize the sputtering Soviet economy and open up Soviet society, efforts known as perestroika and glasnoSt.
sentences.zh: 在其执政的六年里，戈尔巴乔夫试图将步履蹒跚的苏联经济现代化，并开放苏联社会，这些努力被称为“经济改革”和“公开性”。

sentences.en: He sought to end the nuclear standoff with the West through a series of arms control treaties and outreach to Western leaders, including Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 他试图通过一系列军控条约以及向包括罗纳德·里根在内的西方领导人伸出橄榄枝，来结束与西方的核对峙。

sentences.en: Come here to this gate.
sentences.zh: 来到这道门前。

sentences.en: Mr. Gorbachev, open this gate.
sentences.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫先生，打开这道门。

sentences.en: Mr. Gorbachev, Mr. Gorbachev, tear down this wall.
sentences.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫先生，戈尔巴乔夫先生，拆掉这堵墙。

sentences.en: Gorbachev believed he could reform the Soviet system.
sentences.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫相信他能够改革苏联体制。

sentences.en: But the economic and social changes he unleashed ended up pulling the country apart.
sentences.zh: 但他引发的经济和社会变革最终导致了这个国家四分五裂。

sentences.en: In 1991, Kremlin hardliners staged a coup against him.
sentences.zh: 1991年，克里姆林宫的强硬派对发动了一场针对他的政变。

sentences.en: He resigned and the Soviet Union dissolved into 15 independent countries.
sentences.zh: 他辞职了，苏联解体成了15个独立的国家。

sentences.en: In a televised address, he said the country had earned the world's respect by opening up to it.
sentences.zh: 在电视讲话中，他说这个国家通过向世界开放赢得了世界的尊重。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
